meta.title: Modelo de datos AS IS: tres sistemas
meta.subtitle: HubSpot, Product DB y Vitally antes de la resolucion de identidad

erDiagram
    COMPANIES {
        string hubspot_id PK
        string name
        string domain
        string segment
        string industry
        decimal mrr
        string currency
        date signup_date
        string csm_owner
        string plan
        string state
        date churn_date
    }

    DEALS {
        string deal_id PK
        string hubspot_id FK
        string stage
        decimal amount
        date created_date
        date close_date
        string owner
        string pipeline
        string lead_source
    }

    MARKETING_TOUCHES {
        string touch_id PK
        string hubspot_id FK
        string channel
        date touch_date
        string campaign
    }

    ACCOUNTS {
        string account_id PK
        string hubspot_id FK
        string account_name
        date created_at
    }

    PRODUCT_USAGE {
        string account_id PK, FK
        string month PK
        int active_users
        int logins
        int payroll_runs_completed
        int features_used
        int api_calls
    }

    CUSTOMERS {
        string vitally_id PK
        string domain
        string company_name
        string csm_email
    }

    TICKETS {
        string ticket_id PK
        string vitally_id FK
        date created_date
        string priority
        string status
        string category
        decimal resolution_hours
        decimal csat_score
    }
